title: Automation

blocks.p: Before continuing with the rules, this section will hopefully inform you of all the automation features available in Legends of Sinnoh.

blocks.digital: In this game, the game handles all of the Tabletop Simulator automation features below for you.

blocks.p: Apricorns and Journey Points can be moved to and from your bag using the buttons provided in your trainer area. Left click will put the item into your bag, right click will discard the item.

blocks.digital: In this game, the game keeps count of your Apricorns and Journey Points.

blocks.p: The thematic way to get around, you can click the centre of a village to have a Staraptor transport your trainer token to that village [[overview.village|see Villages for rules]].

blocks.digital: In this game, the game moves your trainer token when you choose to fly.

blocks.p: Each of the Dice Roller panels in the arena calculate the bonus/penalty damage from type effectiveness automatically when selecting a move type.
By having the small green button toggled on, you can search through all move types instead of just the ones your currently active Pokémon can learn.

blocks.digital: In this game, the game calculates type effectiveness damage.

blocks.p: Pokémon in this game can end up with many objects on them as they learn new moves, hold items and take damage/status effects. To move all of these objects together easily, you can instead use the Poké Ball token of the Pokémon to move them about.

blocks.caption: Poké Ball token in your trainer area linked to Infernape.
Poké Ball token moved to the arena, Infernape along with any moves, items and dice are moved to the arena also.

blocks.p: Important: Make sure to increase your lift height in Tabletop Simulator if you are having trouble with the Poké Balls linking to other Pokémon in your party accidently when moving them around.

blocks.digital: In this game, the game moves the Pokémon together with its moves, held items and dice.
